execution_gate.reason: InterHuman work starts only after the active Inter-X no-shape and AMASS shape-augmentation experiments finish.
execution_gate.baseline_policy: Do not rerun the InterHuman baseline already being evaluated on the user's other server.

official_data.processed_representation: official InterMask process_motion_np output, 262 dimensions per person; paired HHC VQ input is [person1_262, person2_262] = 524D

released_loader_exclusions_after_file_pr.blank_line_annotations: retained by released readlines/replace behavior as empty-caption choices, not filtered

official_data.stats_identity: byte-identical to the CoShMDM InterHuman global_mean/global_std files

representation.vq_window_dataset: InterHumanVQWindowDataset: deterministic official-split order and eight paired HHC variants spanning the released loader's independent left/right augmentation, coordinate-anchor choice and final output-person order; official default window_size=64/window_stride=10, lazy hash-bound released preprocessing and bounded per-worker cache
representation.partition_requirement: For each person every one of 262 features belongs to exactly one channel; concatenated paired masks are also disjoint/exhaustive over all 524 features, so one HHC token pair jointly represents both people.

forbidden_reuse: Inter-X SMPL-X 55-joint evaluator as an InterHuman headline evaluator

vq_stage.model_family: two-channel separate-quantizer paired VQ over two official 262-dimensional InterHuman representations (524D total)
vq_stage.architecture_selection: Run a bounded reconstruction pilot before freezing codebook and latent widths; do not assume that the Inter-X raw-12288 dimensions transfer unchanged.
vq_stage.preregistered_pilot: configs/interhuman_vq_pilot_v1.json; official-scale 1024-code/512D/depth-2 starting point, 10k-step gate, online W&B, fixed official-val metrics, and no unregistered capacity sweep
vq_stage.training_entrypoint: train/train_vq_interhuman.py; refuses launch without --confirm-after-interx, rejects preregistration drift or non-online W&B, uses exact step-resumable deterministic epoch batches and atomic full-state checkpoints including otherwise-unregistered EMA quantizer state and all RNG state
vq_stage.loss_implementation: utils/interhuman_vq_loss.py; each person's terms have term-by-term numerical parity with the hash-frozen released InterMask loss, paired training averages both people's geometric terms and counts the joint commitment term once

official_loss_terms.reconstruction: SmoothL1 over dimensions 0:258; foot-contact labels excluded
official_loss_terms.foot_sliding: foot velocity on target-contact frames after denormalization

vq_stage.acceptance_before_mgt: Select by official InterHuman evaluator reconstruction FID, while reporting MPJPE and every loss component; reject a VQ with materially worse reconstruction than the official InterMask checkpoint under the same test loader.
vq_stage.validation_implementation: utils/interhuman_vq_evaluation.py; groups samples by true length, pads only to the VQ temporal factor, excludes padded frames from MPJPE/MAE, preserves training RNG/model mode, and computes official val FID/R-Precision/Matching/Diversity on exactly five complete batches
vq_stage.official_intermask_vq_reference_exporter: tools/export_official_intermask_interhuman_vq_reconstruction.py; strict original-source and best_fid.tar hashes, original 1024-code/512D/depth-2 architecture, true-length per-person reconstruction, frozen-request binding and non-overwriting LZF output

mgt_stage.data_contract: configs/interhuman_mgt_data_contract_v1.json; dataset/interhuman_mgt.py reproduces the official text loader's stochastic support, while frozen VQ encoding occurs online after crop/process/pad to preserve boundary-token numerics
mgt_stage.initial_design: historical high-performing HHC topology adapted only at token interfaces: hidden dimension 1024, 16 heads, 7 global plus 2 local base blocks, followed by 9 output blocks
mgt_stage.training_mask: paper kinematic mask-ratio distribution with independent sorted tau values and historical pkeep=0.5 corruption
mgt_stage.training_loss: historical all-valid token cross entropy unless an InterHuman pilot demonstrates a reproducible regression

sampling.order: Root -> Body -> Hands/arms with immediate within-iteration updates

evaluation.primary: official InterMask InterHuman evaluator and data loader
evaluation.checkpoint_selection_requests: output/interhuman_validation_requests/manifest.json; fixed official val split only, 547 eligible entries truncated by released batch_size=96/drop_last to 480; formal test requests are forbidden for model selection
evaluation.fairness: Freeze the same test requests, lengths, text, seeds, replication count, batch size and drop_last behavior for HHC and the external baseline result.
evaluation.request_builder: tools/build_interhuman_fair_requests.py; v3 includes released min_length=15, UTF-8 failure and caption-strip behavior, stores only replay choices and provenance, while GT is reconstructed on demand from official raw motion
evaluation.request_replay_dataset: dataset/interhuman_fair_requests.py; v3 validates manifest/file/content/adapter hashes and yields official (name,text,motion1,motion2,length) batches in frozen order
evaluation.generated_h5_contract: dataset/interhuman_generated_h5.py; requires normalized float32 [1056,300,262] per person and exact frozen name/text/length/request/stat hashes
evaluation.main_scorer: tools/score_fair_interhuman_main.py; released InterCLIP and metric source, batch-local R-Precision, scale=6, divisor=2, 300-pair Diversity and full artifact provenance
evaluation.mm_request_builder: tools/build_interhuman_mm_requests.py; freezes 100 prompts from the full 1098-entry effective replication order, 30 repeats and 10 evaluator pairs
evaluation.mm_generated_h5_contract: dataset/interhuman_generated_h5.py; normalized float32 [100,30,300,262] per person, exact name/text/length/request/stat binding, and SHA256-derived independent repeat seeds
evaluation.mm_scorer: tools/score_fair_interhuman_mm.py; released InterCLIP and official calculate_multimodality with 100 prompts, 30 repeats, 10 sampled pairs, scale=6 and divisor=2
evaluation.formal_aggregator: tools/aggregate_fair_interhuman_metrics.py; requires 20 main plus 20 MM replications, rehashes generation artifacts, verifies request and evaluator provenance, and enforces identical checkpoint/VQ/model-config/common50 identity across main, MM and replications before reporting mean and 95% CI

training: codebook usage and perplexity for VQ
logging.checkpoint_selection: held-out validation only; never select on test metrics
